description: A knot of straw pressed into a bowl by something that slept in it. Still warm, occasionally.
lore: Sold off the same board as the tinder, worth about as much, and there is only the one selling point — which a seller demonstrates by taking your wrist and putting your hand down into the middle of it. Usually it is cold. Now and then it is not, and then you are buying a bed out from under something due back within the hour, and the price goes up rather than down, because people are people.

Look before you let anyone put your hand in. A [[monsters/hedgehog|Quillkin]] sheds as it sleeps, the quills go in barbed and come out worse, and every dealer on that road can point you at the man who found this out in front of a crowd. He tells it himself now. He holds up the three fingers.
gm_notes: Market patter with a barb in it. The three fingers grew back with him; he keeps the joke because it sells nests.
